title: Light with foil
kid_text: A grown-up heats the thin foil.
safety: Foil gets hot fast. Keep it off your skin.

steps.text: Cut the foil so the middle is thin.
Put tinder under that thin spot.
Touch each end of the foil to the cell.
Keep your fingers off the hot spot.

mistakes.text: The foil is the same width all the way.
mistakes.fix: Make the middle into a thin neck.
Hold the foil by the ends.
